headline_hook: Claude Code's Hidden Token Tax Exposed While Open Models Get Six Months to Live

pick_of_the_day.thesis: The open-model viability crisis isn't about benchmarks — it's about the economic flywheel where closed-model revenue funds compute that open labs can't match, and six months is the window before the gap becomes permanently unbridgeable for builders who bet on open weights.

model_literacy.relevance: The Claude Code token analysis reveals that agentic systems spend 70-80% of context on scaffolding before user content — understanding this hidden tax explains why context window size matters less than effective usable context for real coding workflows.
